## Description

Rank companies by book equity relative to market value and buy relatively cheap names.

## Where it may fit

Long-horizon value regimes and periods when cheap stocks mean-revert or earnings normalize.

## Vehicles

Value mutual funds/ETFs, equity long-short and smart-beta portfolios.

## Required data

Point-in-time fundamentals, market cap, industry classifications, prices, delisting returns.

## Caveats

Accounting data publication lags, value traps, sector bias and long periods of underperformance matter.
